proof_body:
by
  intro H _ _ _ T a x hN hx
  have hN' : IsStarNormal (T - a • (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)) := by
    have h0 : IsStarNormal T := by
      rw [isStarNormal_iff, commute_iff_eq, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
      exact hN
    rw [isStarNormal_iff, commute_iff_eq]
    have h1 := h0.star_comm_self.eq
    simp only [star_sub, star_smul, star_one, mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, mul_one, one_mul, h1]
    module
  have h := (ContinuousLinearMap.isStarNormal_iff_norm_eq_adjoint.mp hN') x
  have h1 : (T - a • (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)) x = 0 := by simp [hx]
  rw [h1, norm_zero] at h
  have h2 := norm_eq_zero.mp h.symm
  have h3 : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (T - a • (1 : H →L[ℂ] H)) x = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T x - (starRingEnd ℂ) a • x := by
    simp [map_sub, map_smulₛₗ]
  rw [h3, sub_eq_zero] at h2
  exact h2
target_source: ∀ (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] (T : H →L[ℂ] H) (a : ℂ) (x : H), (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T).comp T = T.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T) → T x = a • x → ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint T x = (starRingEnd ℂ) a • x
